notes.title: 🔥 LUST Eternal 🔞 is OUT NOW! 🔥
notes.content:
You’ve died once — now Hell is your playground.

LUST Eternal is a brutal, fast-paced shooter where you rise from the ashes with a shotgun in one hand and a craving for carnage in the other. Rip through hordes of demons, crush Hell’s guardians, and claim your sinful rewards with the most seductive creatures the underworld has to offer.

What awaits inside?
💥 Explosive, high-speed combat — run, shoot, destroy!
🩸 Savage powers — kinetic blasts, mines, rage, and more
👿 Sinful rewards — prove yourself and indulge in Hell’s finest succubi
🔫 Upgradable weapons — build your own path of destruction
⚔️ Epic boss fights — every victory brings you deeper into madness

🎁 KEY GIVEAWAY TIME!
To celebrate the launch, we’re giving away FREE GAME KEYS to the fastest sinners!
First come — first served 😈
